facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports over 120,000 Addis Abeba government employees enrolled in Udacity courses in coding, AI, Android and data science under a city programme, with enrolment begun a year earlier and certificates being issued.
facts.system: Udacity digital training (Addis Abeba Innovation & Technology Development Bureau)

facts.fact: Addis Fortune says Ethiopia announced on 27 July 2024, with the UAE government, a programme to give five million Ethiopians digital skills (five million coders).
